viewing_check: Find a hallmark (375, 9ct, Birmingham anchor/lion marks) on the locket edge, bail and chain clasp/barrel with a loupe; check if locket is solid or gold-lined/filled (wear to base metal on engraving); weigh locket and chain separately; check for hair or photos inside, and chain links for repairs or plated wear.
